Plan a charging site

Charging should belong to the place.

Wayline brings electrical planning, installation and daily operation together for properties making room for electric travel.

Why we exist

A charging bay is part of a bigger place.

The electrical design has to be sound. But so does the experience of arriving at a hotel, parking at work or coming home. Those details determine whether charging becomes a useful part of a property or a source of daily friction.

Wayline works at that intersection. We bring site assessment, electrical delivery and an ongoing charging service under one responsibility. The owner knows what has been built, the driver knows how to use it and the property team knows who to call.

Start with the site.

Power capacity, parking patterns and the property’s daily rhythm shape the answer before hardware does.

Build for change.

We size the first phase for the demand in front of us and plan the electrical route for the demand still to come.

Stay responsible.

Monitoring, reporting and maintenance stay with Wayline after commissioning.

The work in practice

From one bay to a site-wide service.
